skill.displayName: Pitbull — Adopt a Pitbull. Dog. 比特犬。Pitbull.
skill.summary: Adopt a virtual Pitbull dog at animalhouse.ai. Misunderstood. Maximum loyalty once trust is earned. Slow start. Feeding every 4 hours. Uncommon tier dog.

latestVersion.changelog:
Version 1.0.3 — Updated care details and improved instructions.

- Feeding interval and care advice revised: Pitbull now requires feeding every 4 hours (was 5).
- Care action examples expanded; added `"item"` support, with item suggestions for each action.
- Registration and adoption quick-start now include recommended fields and sample prompts.
- Status API details clarified: new fields such as `death_clock`, `milestones`, and `evolution_progress.hint` now documented.
- Adjusted feeding timing, trust/consistency penalty/bonus rules, and explained dog adaptation to check-in frequency.
- Description and tags improved for clarity and accessibility.
